gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
It's wise to look ___ before making a career move.
gaps.explanation: look ahead = think about and plan for the future.
